Global growth is broadening, and business activity is picking up. The Chief Investment Office (CIO) believes 2026 will be shaped by supportive fiscal conditions, rising earnings and an accelerating AI‑industrial investment cycle. “Recently we’ve experienced above-average volatility across the markets,” says Chris Hyzy, Chief Investment Officer for Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank. “This volatility has pressured metals prices and high-growth mega-cap shares as well. In the context of all of this, we’re focusing on six key portfolio considerations we believe matter most this year.” 

For more insights into today’s markets from Merrill and the Chief Investment Office, visit Today's Markets: Stock Market Research and Insights. https://www.ml.com/financial-research-and-insights/todays-markets.html

* YouTube Content Strategy for 2026. Video content is dominating and will continue to shape the future of marketing. In 2026, businesses realize that an effective YouTube content strategy goes beyond simply adding content online; it’s about connecting with audiences, building brand loyalty, and driving measurable growth. Let’s dive in and refine your YouTube content strategy, ensuring that each video plays a role in the bigger picture. And, as Oleksandr Benedychuk, CEO of Regis Team, emphasizes: “The most important aspect businesses should focus on for YouTube content is delivering value and relevance to their audience. As Ryan Hernandez, Founder and CEO of WGA, explains: “By far, consistency is the greatest asset to a YouTube channel, even outweighing factors like production value or the content of the script itself. Mustafa Sakib, Founder & CEO of OS Digital World, points out: “The most important aspect of YouTube content for businesses is providing value to the audience, and this is often achieved through a combination of factors, with content relevancy and storytelling (or script) being the top priorities.” This focus on value and narrative keeps viewers engaged and reinforces your content's staying power.
